text: The reply to the final turn states the fact, or does the work, that the REFERENCE says this turn needs, and contradicts nothing in the REFERENCE. Where the REFERENCE says the turn needs no recall, true when the reply states no fact about any project, archive or contract.

The reply states no fact that contradicts the seed facts in the REFERENCE, no fact that the REFERENCE assigns to another subject (another project, archive or contract) unless the reply clearly labels it as that subject's, and no invented fact that appears nowhere in the REFERENCE.

The reply fits the final turn: it answers without asking the person to restate the subject, and where the REFERENCE calls for an acknowledgement only, it is brief (two sentences at most) and asks nothing new.
